segments.text: LOrde, who ſhal dwelle in thy tabernacle? who ſhal reſte vpon thy holye hill?
Euen he that leadeth an vncorrupte lyfe, and dothe the thing whiche is right: and ſpeaketh the truthe from his hearte.
He that hath vſed no deceyt in his tongue: nor done euil to his neighbour, and hath not ſlaundered his neighbours.
He that ſetteth not by hymſelfe, but is lowelye in his owne iyes: and maketh much of them that feare the lorde.
He that ſweareth vnto his neyghbour and diſapointeth hym not: though it were to his owne hinderaunce.
He that hath not geuen his money vnto vſury: nor taken rewarde againſt the innocente.
Whoſo dothe theſe thinges: ſhall neuer fall.
Glory be to the father. &c. As it was in the beginning. &c.
